input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: The shape check before Editor.edit_files tests only for os.PathLike and no longer wraps a plain str, so a string filename is passed on as an iterable and consumed character by character when building the editor command.
- failure path: click.edit(filename="notes.txt") launches the editor with the nine single-character files n, o, t, e, s, ., t, x, t instead of notes.txt; saving creates stray files in the working directory and the intended file is never opened.

Reviewer finding
- description: The new check stops wrapping string filenames as a single file. Preserve the string check alongside the new PathLike check.
- rationale: With an existing call such as edit(filename="notes.txt"), the string now passes directly to edit_files as an iterable of individual characters. The editor receives separate character filenames instead of notes.txt, so it opens the wrong files and may save edits to unintended files.
critique: The finding describes the same mechanism as the label. The check no longer wraps a plain str, so the filename is iterated character by character into separate editor filenames. It also gives the same consequence: the wrong files are opened and stray files may be saved.
